name: Division
description: Unsigned schriftliche Binärdivision mit n festen Subtraktions-/Auswahlstufen. c=a//b, rest=a%b. Bei b=0: c=0, rest=0, valid=0, div0=1; sonst valid=1, div0=0.
source:
def subtract<w>(a, b):
    x = bits(a, w)
    y = bits(b, w)
    result = [0] * (w + 1)
    borrow = 0
    for i in range(w):
        parity = x[i] ^ y[i]
        result[i] = parity ^ borrow
        borrow = ((1 ^ x[i]) & y[i]) | ((1 ^ parity) & borrow)
    result[w] = borrow
    return pack(result)

# Restoring division: n feste Stufen, keine datenabhaengigen Schleifen.
x = bits(a, n)
y = bits(b, n)
quotient = [0] * n
remainder = [0] * (n + 1)
for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
    remainder = [x[i]] + remainder[:n]
    difference = bits(subtract<n+1>(pack(remainder), b), n + 2)
    take = 1 ^ difference[n + 1]
    for j in range(n + 1):
        remainder[j] = (difference[j] & take) | (remainder[j] & (1 ^ take))
    quotient[i] = take
valid = 0
for i in range(n):
    valid = valid | y[i]
for i in range(n):
    quotient[i] = quotient[i] & valid
    remainder[i] = remainder[i] & valid
return pack(quotient), pack(remainder[:n]), valid, 1 ^ valid
